ECC.name: SAP ECC 6.0
ECC.note: MM, PP, PM, QM, SD and CO tables: MARA/MARC/MARD/MBEW, MKPF/MSEG, MDKP/MDTB, PLAF, EBAN, AUFK/AFKO/AFPO/AFRU, MAST/STKO/STPO, AENR, EQUI, QMEL, QALS, EKKO/EKPO/EKBE, VBAK/VBAP/VBEP, LIKP/LIPS, VTTK/VFKP, KEKO/KEPH, COSB.

S4.name: SAP S/4HANA
S4.note: Same tables where S/4HANA keeps them; MATDOC replaces MKPF/MSEG, PPH_DBVM (MRP Live) replaces MDKP/MDTB, BUT000 carries partner names.

BDC.name: SAP BDC
BDC.note: Zero-copy SAP BDC data products for master data, sales, stock, material documents, production orders, BOMs, purchasing, quality and deliveries. No MRP, planned orders, PIRs, freight, variances or plant maintenance.

MES.name: MES / IoT shop-floor systems
MES.note: Equipment sensor readings, outages, production lots, final test and serial genealogy from the shop floor.

APS.name: Advanced planning system (SAP IBP / Kinaxis / o9 style)
APS.note: Statistical demand forecasts by material, location and week with forecast version, the consensus demand plan, and S&OP scenarios (demand, capacity and fill rate per scenario). Keyed by SAP material and plant.

POS_EDI.name: Customer sell-through and inventory feeds (EDI 852 / 867, retailer portals)
POS_EDI.note: Weekly sell-through and on-hand inventory reported by distributors and retail customers, keyed by the customer's GTIN and ship-to; used for demand sensing.

WMS.name: Warehouse management system (Manhattan / Blue Yonder style)
WMS.note: Pick, put-away and replenishment tasks with timestamps and operator, and bin occupancy by warehouse zone. Bridges to SAP deliveries and plants.

CARRIER.name: Carrier / TMS visibility (project44-style)
CARRIER.note: Shipment tracking events (pickup, in transit, delivered / proof of delivery) keyed by carrier tracking number and ERP delivery number. Gives the actual delivery date for true OTIF.

SUPPLIER_RISK.name: Supplier risk intelligence (D&B / EcoVadis style)
SUPPLIER_RISK.note: Financial stress and failure scores and risk class by D-U-N-S number, sanctions and adverse-media screening by tax id, and ESG ratings.

WEATHER.name: Weather and degree-day service
WEATHER.note: Daily heating and cooling degree days, temperature, wind and precipitation by weather station and utility territory. Used for consumption normalization and churn risk in use case 16.

COMMODITY_INDEX.name: Raw material price indices (LME / Fastmarkets / ICIS style)
COMMODITY_INDEX.note: Monthly price indices for steel, aluminium, copper, resin and corrugate, used to explain standard-cost exposure and purchase price variance.

FX_RATES.name: FX reference rates (ECB / frankfurter.dev style)
FX_RATES.note: Daily FX reference rates used to convert document currency to a reporting currency.

profiles.name: SAP SLT / direct replication
profiles.note: Native table and column names and types, as SAP SLT, Snowflake Openflow or a replication partner configured for native shape lands them. Today's bronze.

profiles.name: Fivetran
profiles.vendor: Fivetran (SAP ERP on HANA, SAP NetWeaver, SAP OData connectors)
profiles.note: Uppercase names; '/' in SAP namespaces becomes '_'. Adds _FIVETRAN_SYNCED; soft-delete mode adds _FIVETRAN_DELETED, history mode adds _FIVETRAN_ACTIVE/_START/_END, no-trigger mode _FIVETRAN_ID.

profiles.name: Qlik Replicate
profiles.vendor: Qlik Replicate / Qlik Cloud Data Integration (SAP Application, SAP HANA endpoints)
profiles.note: Native names. DATS/TIMS often land as text. Soft deletes via an operation_indicator column (default DELETE_FLAG = 'D'); Store Changes writes <table>__CT change tables with header__ columns, which are ignored.

profiles.name: Other ELT tool (configurable)
profiles.vendor: SNP Glue, Theobald Xtract, Informatica, AWS AppFlow, Azure Data Factory, ...
profiles.note: Set OPTIONS on CONFIG.INGESTION: table_prefix, audit_columns (regex), delete_column + delete_value, cast_text_types.
